Sprint S20 — InkOS Flash & Portfolio module. Full plan at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/.handoffs/s20-flash-portfolio-plan.md` — READ FIRST.

**IMPORTANT: Plan mode is OFF. Write files.**

**Working directory:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS`
**Stack:** Next.js 16, Supabase SSR, Tailwind 4, base-ui, TypeScript strict with `exactOptionalPropertyTypes: true`.

## Schema already landed (my commits above yours)

- `supabase/migrations/20260425100000_s20a_flash_event_assets_bucket.sql` — bucket + RLS (public-read when event published, studio-member write).
- `supabase/migrations/20260425100100_s20c_artist_portfolio_items.sql` — `artist_portfolio_items` table + `artist-portfolio` public bucket (10MB, public read).
- `supabase/migrations/20260425100200_s20d_style_tags.sql` — `style_tags` table + 10 default tags seeded per studio + `flash_event_designs.style_tag_ids` uuid[] column + auto-seed on studio create.

Types.ts already updated with all 3: `artist_portfolio_items`, `style_tags` (both Row/Insert/Update), and `style_tag_ids` field on `flash_event_designs`.

## Existing foundation (don't rebuild)

- `lib/flash-events/queries.ts` — full CRUD queries for flash events/designs/slots
- `lib/flash-events/mutations.ts` — full mutation layer
- Public flash booking: `/book/[studioSlug]/flash/[eventSlug]` flow END-TO-END WORKS
- Public API: `/api/public/flash/[studioSlug]/[eventSlug]` + `/slots` + `/reserve`
- `booking_photos` table with kinds (reference|before|during|after|healed)
- Artists have `slug` column + public route at `/book/[studioSlug]/artist/[artistSlug]`

## Execute all 5 parts

### Part A — Admin Flash Event CRUD UI (2d)

**Pages:**
- `app/(app)/flash-events/page.tsx` — list view with tabs Upcoming / Past / Draft. Uses `listFlashEvents()`. Empty state → "Create first event" CTA.
- `app/(app)/flash-events/new/page.tsx` — create form (fields per `flash_events` schema; posts to new `/api/flash-events`).
- `app/(app)/flash-events/[id]/page.tsx` — event detail with internal tabs: Overview / Designs / Slots / Bookings.
  - Overview: cover image, date, artist, slot count, status pill, revenue summary. Actions: Publish / Cancel / Edit.
  - Designs: list of designs with drag-to-reorder, add/edit/remove. Each design: image upload (to `flash-event-assets`), title, size_description, placement_options, price_cents override, style_tag_ids picker, sold_out toggle.
  - Slots: visual grid — X days × Y time slots. Colors: open=neutral, reserved=yellow, booked=green, blocked=gray. Click open/blocked to toggle blocked state.
  - Bookings: list of slot_status='booked' with client/artist/deposit details.

**Components:**
- `components/flash-events/FlashEventsList.tsx`
- `components/flash-events/FlashEventForm.tsx` (create + edit)
- `components/flash-events/FlashDesignManager.tsx` (grid + add modal + edit modal)
- `components/flash-events/FlashSlotGrid.tsx`
- `components/flash-events/FlashEventCoverUpload.tsx`
- `components/flash-events/FlashStatusPill.tsx`

**API routes:**
- `app/api/flash-events/route.ts` — POST (create)
- `app/api/flash-events/[id]/route.ts` — GET/PATCH/DELETE
- `app/api/flash-events/[id]/publish/route.ts` — POST
- `app/api/flash-events/[id]/cancel/route.ts` — POST
- `app/api/flash-events/[id]/designs/route.ts` — POST + reorder
- `app/api/flash-events/[id]/designs/[designId]/route.ts` — PATCH/DELETE
- `app/api/flash-events/[id]/slots/[slotId]/block/route.ts` — POST toggle

All use `getAuthenticatedUser()` + role check (owner/admin/artist) + `authedRatelimit`. Leverage existing `lib/flash-events/mutations.ts` functions.

**Sidebar:**
- `components/app/sidebar/nav-config.ts` — add "Flash Events" under GROWTH section (after AI), href `/flash-events`, icon `Sparkles` or `Palette`, requiredRoles `['owner', 'admin', 'artist']`.

### Part B — Flash discovery on public booking (1d)

- `app/book/[studioSlug]/page.tsx` — add "Upcoming Flash Events" section above services. Pull with anon query: events where studio_id=X AND status='published' AND event_date >= today, order by event_date, limit 6.
- Event card: cover image, event date + artist name + "X of Y slots remaining" + CTA button linking to `/book/[studioSlug]/flash/[eventSlug]`
- Only render section if at least 1 upcoming published event exists.

### Part C — Artist portfolio system (2d)

**Admin:**
- `app/(app)/artists/[id]/page.tsx` — add "Portfolio" tab next to existing tabs. 
- `components/portfolio/ArtistPortfolioManager.tsx`:
  - Grid of portfolio items with drag-to-reorder (use @dnd-kit — already installed)
  - Per-item: toggle featured (star), edit caption, edit style_tag_ids, delete
  - "Add item" button opens two flows:
    1. Upload new image (to `artist-portfolio` bucket at path `{studio_id}/{artist_id}/{filename}`)
    2. "Promote from client photos" → modal showing this artist's completed bookings with `booking_photos WHERE kind='healed'`; checkbox select; on confirm, COPY storage (or link via `linked_booking_photo_id`) and insert portfolio_items row
  - Caption editor inline, style tag picker inline

**Client detail (promote photo):**
- `app/(app)/clients/[id]/photos/page.tsx` — add "Add to artist portfolio" action on healed photos (icon button on hover, opens quick modal: artist dropdown + caption + style tags)

**Public render:**
- `app/book/[studioSlug]/artist/[artistSlug]/page.tsx` — add portfolio gallery section below bio. Query `artist_portfolio_items WHERE artist_id = X ORDER BY display_order`. Render as grid with lightbox (reuse existing `<ImageLightbox>` or build one). Show style tag chips on each item.

**Studio-wide /portfolio:**
- Replace `app/(app)/portfolio/page.tsx` (currently stub `<PortfolioComingSoon>`) with real gallery.
- Fetches all `artist_portfolio_items WHERE studio_id = X AND is_featured = true` across all artists.
- Filters: artist dropdown, style tag pills.
- Grid layout with artist name overlay on hover, click → artist's portfolio detail (can route to same `/artists/[id]?tab=portfolio`)
- Keep old `components/portfolio/PortfolioComingSoon.tsx` but don't use it.

**API routes:**
- `app/api/portfolio/route.ts` — POST (create item), GET (list for artist)
- `app/api/portfolio/[id]/route.ts` — PATCH (caption/tags/featured), DELETE
- `app/api/portfolio/reorder/route.ts` — POST with ordered IDs
- `app/api/portfolio/promote/route.ts` — POST with `{ booking_photo_id, artist_id, caption?, style_tag_ids? }` — reads the booking photo, copies storage path into `artist-portfolio` bucket (or just links via linked_booking_photo_id and copies path), creates portfolio_items row

**Libs:**
- `lib/portfolio/portfolio.ts` — fetchArtistPortfolio, createPortfolioItem, promoteFromBookingPhoto helpers

### Part D — Style tags (1d)

**Settings page:**
- `app/(app)/settings/studio/style-tags/page.tsx` — CRUD table for style tags
- Components: `components/settings/studio/StyleTagsManager.tsx`, `StyleTagEditor.tsx`
- Settings sidebar nav: add "Style Tags" under Studio group

**Inline pickers:**
- `components/shared/StyleTagPicker.tsx` (NEW) — reusable multi-select for any form (used in flash design editor + portfolio item editor)
- Shows chips with color/icon when selected

**Public filtering:**
- `/portfolio` page — filter pills by style tag (toggle one or more, filters items via `style_tag_ids && $1` array overlap)
- Flash event page (public) — style tag chips on each design + filter

**API:**
- `app/api/style-tags/route.ts` — GET (studio list) + POST (create)
- `app/api/style-tags/[id]/route.ts` — PATCH / DELETE
- Seed happens in DB trigger (already done by migration 3)

### Part E — Already done (migration)

bucket auto-create is part of migration 1. Nothing for Koda.

## Constraints

- TypeScript strict + exactOptionalPropertyTypes
- No `any`
- Server components use `@supabase/ssr` (lib/supabase/server.ts)
- base-ui primitives
- Drag-reorder via @dnd-kit (already installed — check imports)
- Image upload to Supabase storage: use `supabase.storage.from('artist-portfolio').upload(...)` server-side after validating MIME + size
- Public pages access `artist-portfolio` bucket directly (it's public-read)
- Flash event assets: path `{studio_id}/{event_id}/{filename}`; portfolio: `{studio_id}/{artist_id}/{filename}`
- Lightbox: reuse existing if present, else build minimal

## Final verification

```bash
cd "/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS"
pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint --max-warnings=0 && pnpm build
```

## Report

- Files created (list)
- Files modified (list)
- Verification exit codes
- Judgment calls
- Known-issues punch list

Ship production-grade. Follow the plan. Good luck.

1	# InkOS — Project Context for Claude Code
2	
3	**Stack:** A (Next.js 16.2.3 + Supabase + Railway + Dodo Payments)
4	**Status:** Sprint 12 complete — launch-ready
5	**Scaffolded by:** Riko on 2026-04-15
6	**Build plan:** `~/.claude/plans/immutable-conjuring-pelican.md` (12 sprints — ALL COMPLETE)
7	
8	---
9	
10	## What InkOS Is
11	
12	Multi-tenant tattoo studio management SaaS. Authenticated web app only (no marketing pages in v1). 4-tier pricing (Solo $29 / Studio $59 / Pro $99 / Enterprise $199). Multi-user from day 1 (owners + artists + receptionists). 12-sprint build targeting first paying studios at 24 weeks.
13	
14	---
15	
16	## Forbidden (Sage hard-fails)
17	
18	- `@supabase/auth-helpers-nextjs` — use `@supabase/ssr`
19	- Vercel — use Railway
20	- Stripe — use Dodo Payments
21	- NextAuth — use Supabase Auth
22	- Prisma or any ORM — use Supabase client + generated types
23	- Pages Router — App Router only
24	- npm / yarn — pnpm only
25	- CSS modules — Tailwind only
26	- `any` TypeScript type — zero exceptions
27	- `console.log` — use `lib/logger.ts` (pino)
28	- Raw hex colors except `--color-ink-black` and `--color-electric-purple` in `globals.css`
29	- `tailwind.config.ts` — Tailwind 4 uses `@theme inline` in `globals.css` only
30	- Default Tailwind shadows (`shadow-sm`, `shadow-md`) — use `shadow-soft`, `shadow-card`, `shadow-soft-md`
31	
32	---
33	
34	## Key Architecture Decisions
35	
36	1. **Next.js 16 uses `proxy.ts` not `middleware.ts`** — the file is at the project root, not in `app/`
37	2. **`instrumentation-client.ts` is REQUIRED** — missing this = no browser errors in Sentry
38	3. **`cookies()` is async in Next.js 16** — always `await cookies()`
39	4. **Worker packages must NEVER import `next/*`** — separate `package.json` in `workers/`
40	5. **BullMQ ioredis requires `maxRetriesPerRequest: null`** — silent failure without it
41	6. **Supabase service-role client bypasses RLS** — only use in webhook handlers + admin ops
42	7. **Webhook handler uses `timingSafeEqual`** — constant-time HMAC comparison, never `===`
43	8. **Subscriptions table is write-only by webhook** — no app code writes to it directly
44	9. **Tailwind 4 — no `tailwind.config.ts`** — all tokens in `app/globals.css` `@theme inline`
45	
46	---

55	// ── List flash events for a studio ───────────────────────────────────────────
56	
57	export async function listFlashEvents(
58	  studioId: string,
59	  filters: FlashEventFilter = {}
60	): Promise<FlashEventListItem[]> {
61	  const supabase = await createClient()
62	
63	  let query = supabase
64	    .from('flash_events')
65	    .select(`
66	      *,
67	      artist:artists(id, display_name, avatar_url),
68	      location:locations(id, name)
69	    `)
70	    .eq('studio_id', studioId)
71	    .order('event_date', { ascending: false })
72	
73	  if (filters.status && filters.status !== 'all') {
74	    if (filters.status === 'upcoming') {
75	      const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]
76	      query = query.gte('event_date', today)
77	    } else {
78	      query = query.eq('status', filters.status)
79	    }
80	  }
81	
82	  const { data, error } = await query
83	
84	  if (error) {
85	    logger.error({ error, studioId }, 'listFlashEvents failed')
86	    throw new Error('Failed to load flash events')
87	  }
88	
89	  if (!data) return []
90	
91	  // Fetch slot summaries in bulk
92	  const eventIds = data.map((e) => e.id)
93	  const { data: slots } = await supabase
94	    .from('flash_event_slots')
95	    .select('flash_event_id, status')
96	    .in('flash_event_id', eventIds)
97	
98	  const summaryMap = new Map<string, { total: number; booked: number; available: number }>()
99	  for (const slot of slots ?? []) {
100	    const existing = summaryMap.get(slot.flash_event_id) ?? { total: 0, booked: 0, available: 0 }
101	    existing.total += 1
102	    if (slot.status === 'booked') existing.booked += 1
103	    if (slot.status === 'open') existing.available += 1
104	    summaryMap.set(slot.flash_event_id, existing)
105	  }
106	
107	  return data.map((event) => ({
108	    ...event,
109	    artist: (event.artist as FlashEventListItem['artist']) ?? null,
110	    location: (event.location as FlashEventListItem['location']) ?? null,
111	    slot_summary: summaryMap.get(event.id) ?? { total: 0, booked: 0, available: 0 },
112	  }))
113	}

116	// ── Publish a flash event (draft → published + generates slots) ───────────────
117	
118	export async function publishFlashEvent(
119	  studioId: string,
120	  eventId: string
121	): Promise<{ event: FlashEvent; slotsGenerated: number }> {
122	  // Service-role needed to call SECURITY DEFINER RPC
123	  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient()
124	
125	  // Verify ownership (re-check with user client)
126	  const userClient = await createClient()
127	  const { data: event } = await userClient
128	    .from('flash_events')
129	    .select('*')
130	    .eq('studio_id', studioId)
131	    .eq('id', eventId)
132	    .eq('status', 'draft')
133	    .maybeSingle()
134	
135	  if (!event) throw new Error('Event not found, already published, or access denied')
136	
137	  // Generate slots via RPC
138	  const { data: slotsGenerated, error: rpcError } = await supabase.rpc(
139	    'generate_flash_event_slots',
140	    { p_event_id: eventId }
141	  )
142	
143	  if (rpcError) {
144	    logger.error({ error: rpcError, studioId, eventId }, 'generate_flash_event_slots RPC failed')
145	    throw new Error('Failed to generate time slots')
146	  }
147	
148	  // Transition to published
149	  const { data: published, error: updateError } = await supabase
150	    .from('flash_events')
151	    .update({ status: 'published', published_at: new Date().toISOString() })
152	    .eq('id', eventId)
153	    .select()
154	    .single()
155	
156	  if (updateError) {
157	    logger.error({ error: updateError, studioId, eventId }, 'publishFlashEvent status update failed')
158	    throw new Error('Failed to publish event')
159	  }
160	
161	  return { event: published, slotsGenerated: slotsGenerated ?? 0 }
162	}

332	// ── Slot management ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
333	
334	export async function blockSlot(
335	  studioId: string,
336	  eventId: string,
337	  slotId: string
338	): Promise<FlashEventSlot> {
339	  const supabase = await createClient()
340	
341	  const { data: event } = await supabase
342	    .from('flash_events')
343	    .select('id')
344	    .eq('studio_id', studioId)
345	    .eq('id', eventId)
346	    .maybeSingle()
347	
348	  if (!event) throw new Error('Event not found or access denied')
349	
350	  const { data, error } = await supabase
351	    .from('flash_event_slots')
352	    .update({ status: 'blocked' })
353	    .eq('id', slotId)
354	    .eq('flash_event_id', eventId)
355	    .in('status', ['open'])
356	    .select()
357	    .single()
358	
359	  if (error) {
360	    logger.error({ error, studioId, slotId }, 'blockSlot failed')
361	    throw new Error('Failed to block slot')
362	  }
363	
364	  return data
365	}

367	export async function unblockSlot(
368	  studioId: string,
369	  eventId: string,
370	  slotId: string
371	): Promise<FlashEventSlot> {
372	  const supabase = await createClient()
373	
374	  const { data: event } = await supabase
375	    .from('flash_events')
376	    .select('id')
377	    .eq('studio_id', studioId)
378	    .eq('id', eventId)
379	    .maybeSingle()
380	
381	  if (!event) throw new Error('Event not found or access denied')
382	
383	  const { data, error } = await supabase
384	    .from('flash_event_slots')
385	    .update({ status: 'open' })
386	    .eq('id', slotId)
387	    .eq('flash_event_id', eventId)
388	    .eq('status', 'blocked')
389	    .select()
390	    .single()
391	
392	  if (error) {
393	    logger.error({ error, studioId, slotId }, 'unblockSlot failed')
394	    throw new Error('Failed to unblock slot')
395	  }
396	
397	  return data

400	// ── Public: reserve a slot (anon, 15-min hold) ────────────────────────────────
401	
402	export type ReserveSlotResult =
403	  | { success: true; bookingToken: string; bookingId: string; slotId: string }
404	  | { success: false; error: string }
405	
406	export async function reserveSlot(
407	  studioSlug: string,
408	  eventSlug: string,
409	  slotId: string,
410	  clientInfo: {
411	    firstName: string
412	    lastName?: string
413	    email: string
414	    phone?: string
415	    notes?: string
416	  }
417	): Promise<ReserveSlotResult> {
418	  const supabase = createPublicClient()
419	
420	  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('public_reserve_flash_slot', {
421	    p_studio_slug: studioSlug,
422	    p_event_slug: eventSlug,
423	    p_slot_id: slotId,
424	    p_client_info: {
425	      first_name: clientInfo.firstName,
426	      last_name: clientInfo.lastName ?? null,
427	      email: clientInfo.email,
428	      phone: clientInfo.phone ?? null,
429	      notes: clientInfo.notes ?? null,
430	    },
431	  })
432	
433	  if (error) {
434	    logger.error({ error, studioSlug, eventSlug, slotId }, 'reserveSlot RPC failed')
435	    return { success: false, error: 'Unable to reserve slot. Please try again.' }
436	  }
437	
438	  const result = data as Record<string, unknown>
439	  if (result?.error) {
440	    const errMap: Record<string, string> = {
441	      studio_not_found: 'Studio not found.',
442	      event_not_found: 'Event not found or no longer available.',
443	      slot_unavailable: 'That slot is no longer available. Please choose another.',
444	      no_artist_available: 'No artists are available for this event.',
445	    }
446	    return {
447	      success: false,
448	      error: errMap[result.error as string] ?? 'Unable to complete reservation.',
449	    }
450	  }
451	
452	  return {
453	    success: true,
454	    bookingToken: result.booking_token as string,
455	    bookingId: result.booking_id as string,
456	    slotId: result.slot_id as string,
457	  }
458	}
459	
460	// ── Confirm slot after deposit paid (called by webhook) ───────────────────────
461	
462	export async function confirmSlotBooking(bookingId: string): Promise<boolean> {
463	  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient()
464	
465	  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('confirm_flash_slot_booking', {
466	    p_booking_id: bookingId,
467	  })
468	
469	  if (error) {
470	    logger.error({ error, bookingId }, 'confirmSlotBooking RPC failed')
471	    return false
472	  }
473	
474	  return data === true
475	}

15	/**
16	 * Server Supabase client for Server Components, API Route Handlers, and Server Actions.
17	 *
18	 * Uses the anon key + user session cookies.
19	 * RLS policies apply based on the authenticated user.
20	 *
21	 * IMPORTANT: cookies() is async in Next.js 16 — must be awaited.
22	 */
23	export async function createClient() {
24	  const cookieStore = await cookies()
25	
26	  return createServerClient<Database>(
27	    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
28	    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
29	    {
30	      cookies: {
31	        getAll() {
32	          return cookieStore.getAll()
33	        },
34	        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
35	          try {
36	            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
37	              cookieStore.set(name, value, options)
38	            )
39	          } catch {
40	            // setAll called from a Server Component — cookies cannot be set
41	            // middleware handles session refresh
42	          }
43	        },
44	      },
45	    }
46	  )
47	}

49	/**
50	 * Cached helper that validates the session and returns the authenticated user
51	 * together with their primary studio context.
52	 *
53	 * Wrapped in React cache() so repeated calls within the same render tree
54	 * (e.g. layout + page) are deduplicated — only one round-trip per request.
55	 *
56	 * Returns null when the user is not authenticated or has no studio membership.
57	 */
58	export const getAuthenticatedUser = cache(async (): Promise<AuthenticatedUser | null> => {
59	  const supabase = await createClient()
60	  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
61	
62	  if (authError || !user) return null
63	
64	  const [profileResult, memberResult] = await Promise.all([
65	    supabase
66	      .from('profiles')
67	      .select('id, email, full_name, avatar_url, is_platform_admin, created_at, updated_at')
68	      .eq('id', user.id)
69	      .single(),
70	    supabase
71	      .from('studio_members')
72	      .select('studio_id, role')
73	      .eq('user_id', user.id)
74	      .is('deactivated_at', null)
75	      .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
76	      .limit(1)
77	      .single(),
78	  ])
79	
80	  if (profileResult.error || !profileResult.data) return null
81	  if (memberResult.error || !memberResult.data) return null
82	
83	  return {
84	    user: { ...profileResult.data, authId: user.id },
85	    studioId: memberResult.data.studio_id,
86	    role: memberResult.data.role,
87	  }
88	})

95	export function createServiceRoleClient() {

1	/**
2	 * Rate limiters — Upstash Ratelimit.
3	 *
4	 * Falls back to a permissive no-op limiter when UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL /
5	 * UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN are absent (local dev without Redis).
6	 *
7	 * Production MUST have both env vars set or all limiters will always allow
8	 * requests — the startup check in lib/env.ts will warn in that case.
9	 */
10	import { logger } from '@/lib/logger'
11	
12	// ─── Limiter interface (matches Upstash RatelimitResponse shape) ────────────
13	export interface RateLimitResponse {
14	  success: boolean
15	  limit: number
16	  remaining: number
17	  reset: number
18	}
19	
20	export interface Limiter {
21	  limit: (identifier: string) => Promise<RateLimitResponse>
22	}
23	
24	// ─── No-op fallback (used when Redis env vars absent) ───────────────────────
25	function makeNoop(name: string): Limiter {
26	  let warned = false
27	  return {
28	    async limit() {
29	      if (!warned) {
30	        logger.warn(
31	          { limiter: name },
32	          'rate-limit: UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL not set — limiter is permissive (dev mode)',
33	        )
34	        warned = true
35	      }
36	      return { success: true, limit: 9999, remaining: 9999, reset: Date.now() + 60_000 }
37	    },
38	  }
39	}
40	
41	// ─── Real Upstash limiter factory ────────────────────────────────────────────
42	function makeUpstashLimiter(
43	  requests: number,
44	  windowSeconds: number,
45	  name: string,
46	): Limiter {
47	  const url = process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL
48	  const token = process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN
49	
50	  if (!url || !token) {
51	    return makeNoop(name)
52	  }
53	
54	  // Sliding window via Upstash REST API — no Node.js SDK dependency needed.
55	  // Uses the MULTI/EXEC pattern: INCR + EXPIRE in one round-trip.
56	  return {
57	    async limit(identifier: string): Promise<RateLimitResponse> {
58	      const key = `rl:${name}:${identifier}`
59	      const now = Date.now()
60	      const windowMs = windowSeconds * 1_000
61	
62	      try {
63	        // Pipeline: INCR key + EXPIRE key windowSeconds
64	        const pipelineRes = await fetch(`${url}/pipeline`, {
65	          method: 'POST',
66	          headers: {
67	            Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
68	            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
69	          },
70	          body: JSON.stringify([
71	            ['INCR', key],
72	            ['EXPIRE', key, windowSeconds],
73	          ]),
74	        })
75	
76	        if (!pipelineRes.ok) {
77	          logger.warn({ name, status: pipelineRes.status }, 'rate-limit: Upstash pipeline error — allowing request')
78	          return { success: true, limit: requests, remaining: requests, reset: now + windowMs }
79	        }
80	
81	        const results = await pipelineRes.json() as [{ result: number }, { result: number }]
82	        const count = results[0].result
83	
84	        const remaining = Math.max(0, requests - count)
85	        const reset = now + windowMs
86	
87	        if (count > requests) {
88	          return { success: false, limit: requests, remaining: 0, reset }
89	        }
90	
91	        return { success: true, limit: requests, remaining, reset }
92	      } catch (err) {
93	        // On Redis error: fail open (allow) and log
94	        logger.error({ err, name }, 'rate-limit: Redis error — failing open')
95	        return { success: true, limit: requests, remaining: requests, reset: now + windowMs }
96	      }
97	    },
98	  }
99	}
100	
101	// ─── Exported limiters ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
102	// Adjust windows and limits per endpoint risk profile.
103	
104	/** Generic authenticated API calls — 120 req/min per IP */
105	export const apiRatelimit = makeUpstashLimiter(120, 60, 'api')
106	
107	/** Authenticated actions (CRUD) — 60 req/min per IP */
108	export const authedRatelimit = makeUpstashLimiter(60, 60, 'authed')
109	
110	/** Expensive operations (AI generation, PDF export, reports) — 10 req/min */

118	export async function publishFlashEvent(
119	  studioId: string,
120	  eventId: string
121	): Promise<{ event: FlashEvent; slotsGenerated: number }> {
122	  // Service-role needed to call SECURITY DEFINER RPC
123	  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient()
124	
125	  // Verify ownership (re-check with user client)
126	  const userClient = await createClient()
127	  const { data: event } = await userClient
128	    .from('flash_events')
129	    .select('*')
130	    .eq('studio_id', studioId)
131	    .eq('id', eventId)
132	    .eq('status', 'draft')
133	    .maybeSingle()
134	
135	  if (!event) throw new Error('Event not found, already published, or access denied')
136	
137	  // Generate slots via RPC
138	  const { data: slotsGenerated, error: rpcError } = await supabase.rpc(
139	    'generate_flash_event_slots',
140	    { p_event_id: eventId }
141	  )
142	
143	  if (rpcError) {
144	    logger.error({ error: rpcError, studioId, eventId }, 'generate_flash_event_slots RPC failed')
145	    throw new Error('Failed to generate time slots')
146	  }
147	
148	  // Transition to published
149	  const { data: published, error: updateError } = await supabase
150	    .from('flash_events')
151	    .update({ status: 'published', published_at: new Date().toISOString() })
152	    .eq('id', eventId)
153	    .select()
154	    .single()
155	
156	  if (updateError) {
157	    logger.error({ error: updateError, studioId, eventId }, 'publishFlashEvent status update failed')
158	    throw new Error('Failed to publish event')
159	  }
160	
161	  return { event: published, slotsGenerated: slotsGenerated ?? 0 }
